input.quote: 14.1 Term. The term of this Agreement (the "Term") will commence on the Effective Date and will expire upon the earliest of (i) termination of this Agreement in accordance with Section 14.2, or (ii) the date of payment of the last Approval Payment due based on all applicable Regulatory Approvals which have been received.
input.rationale: This is a co-development/funding agreement, not a renewing subscription. Section 14.1 sets a finite, event-based Term that runs from the Effective Date until the earlier of termination under Section 14.2 or payment of the last Approval Payment; the related "Development Term" definition (1.1.60) is likewise tied to Clinical Trial completion and conclusion of Regulatory Approval efforts. Searches for "renew", "automatically renew", "extend the Term", "additional term", and CPI/price-uplift language returned no renewal or evergreen mechanic and no renewal price-increase provision. There is therefore no auto-renewal, no non-renewal notice window and no uplift to cap, so the outcome is at least as good for us as the preferred position (no extension absent mutual agreement/further amendment). No redline needed; the only extension of the relationship would require the parties' agreement.
